topics.title: Photosynthesis
topics.answer: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants make food using light energy, water and carbon dioxide. Oxygen is released as a by-product.
topics.content: Plants use light energy to convert water and carbon dioxide into glucose. Chlorophyll helps capture light energy. This process is important because it produces food for plants and releases oxygen.

topics.title: Percentage
topics.answer: A percentage expresses a number as a fraction of 100. 25% means 25 out of 100.
topics.content: To find a percentage of a number, convert the percentage to a fraction over 100 and multiply. For example, 20% of 50 is (20/100) × 50 = 10.

topics.title: Nouns
topics.description: Learn the basic idea of nouns.
topics.answer: A noun names a person, place, thing or idea.
topics.content: Examples include teacher, Chennai, book and happiness. Common nouns name general things, while proper nouns name specific people or places.

topics.title: HTML Basics
topics.description: Understand the role of HTML on the web.
topics.answer: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language and provides structure for web pages.
topics.content: HTML uses elements such as headings, paragraphs, links, images and forms to describe the structure and meaning of web content.

topics.title: Planet Earth
topics.answer: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and is known to support life.
topics.content: Earth has a diverse surface, an atmosphere and abundant liquid water. It rotates on its axis and orbits the Sun.
